title: AgroBerries Group expands premium blueberry portfolio with new Mountain Blue Orchards licensing agreements
summary: Externally verified via authoritative trade press (not the internal spreadsheet or handwritten notes): AgroBerries Group has signed new licensing agreements with Mountain Blue Orchards (MBO) to grow and market MBO's blueberry genetics across expanded global territories from 2027.
